title: Nvidia with a positive Q3 despite SEC probing Nvidia amid Huang Scandal
summary:
Deirdre Bosa discusses Jensen Huang's statement that he would be willing to return, the SEC's post-scandal probe into Nvidia (NVDA), and Nvidia's positive earnings report. 

Deirdre Bosa then sits down with Mustafa Suleyman, Microsoft's (MSFT) AI chief, to discuss Microsoft's 6 new AI models, the AI competition, and the 'handoverism' worldview.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

title: AI industry still needs to be 'extremely careful,' Microsoft exec says
summary: Microsoft (MSFT) AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman sits down with Deirdre Bosa to talk more about how the industry is erring on the side of caution in how it develops and advances AI further, especially coming after recent hacks and AI-led cyberattacks.

title: Microsoft AI chief says compute isn't a bottleneck — for now
summary:
Microsoft (MSFT) unveiled a slew of new AI models at its Ignite 2026 event on Tuesday.

Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman sits down with Deirdre Bosa to discuss the status of Microsoft's AI compute and the pricing scale it's offering to partner companies.

title: Microsoft's AI pitch at Ignite: Cheaper models as business 'token spend is going through the roof'
summary: Microsoft rolled out new features to its AI initiative and products during its flagship conference on Tuesday. One theme was keeping enterprise costs down.

title: Is AI to blame for basic IT gaps in Big Tech, airlines, and more?
summary:
Siebert Financial chief investment officer Mark Malek and his panel of experts weigh in on the recent outages experienced by companies like Microsoft (MSFT), JPMorgan Chase (JPM), and various airlines last week, and whether the hyperfocus on AI has taken attention away from basic system functions.

Today's panel includes Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman, Solidarity Wealth CEO Jeff McClean, Roundhill Investments ETF strategist Thomas DiFazio, and Alumni Ventures managing partner Laura Rippy.

title: What far cheaper AI compute in space could mean for Elon Musk
summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen explains how SpaceX (SPCX) CEO Elon Musk's ability to scale AI compute on Earth, and potentially in space at a much lower cost, could make his space business a highly lucrative AI compute provider on par with the big cloud businesses like Amazon Web Services (AMZN), Google Cloud (GOOG) (GOOGL), and Microsoft's (MSFT) Azure.

title: JPMorgan, Microsoft, United, FAA service outages: What exactly is going on?
summary:
JPMorgan (JPM), Bank of America (BAC), Wells Fargo (WFC), United Airlines (UAL), Microsoft (MSFT), and the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) all experienced system outages recently.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley discuss the tech-related shortcomings that are contributing to these consumer-facing outages.

title: Cascade of Outages Triggers Conspiracy Theories—and Finger-Pointing
summary: Some of President Trump’s political allies are increasingly frustrated with the government’s response to the outages.

title: Microsoft Stock Hits Seven-Week Low: Is a Bigger Drop Coming?
summary: Microsoft stock hit a 2-month low as rate-hike bets, an Anthropic rival, and outages hit MSFT. See the key support levels.

title: Nvidia says 'no' to rehiring Huang and WSJ reports SEC is probing the chipmaker
summary: WASHINGTON/SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 17 (Reuters) - Nvidia's leadership signaled they would brook no dissent in their plan to find a new CEO, rejecting a "Stand With Jensen" campaign from allies of departed CEO Jensen Huang, even as the Wall Street Journal reported a regulator was probing Nvidia. A growing effort to reinstate Huang had complicated the search, and Huang said on Tuesday he would be "honored" to return if the ‌board deemed it best.
